name: circleci
description: Enables you to reproduce the CircleCI environment locally

repo.name: circleci-cli
repo.description: Use CircleCI from the command line

readme.summary: Excellent installation coverage and clear purpose, but lacks practical usage examples and troubleshooting guidance beyond basic setup.
readme.top_issue: Only one basic usage example (config validate) is shown; most users will need more practical examples of common CircleCI CLI workflows like running local builds, working with orbs, or managing contexts.

security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential SQL injection risks and inadequate input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

sentiment.summary: The circleci CLI shows moderate community engagement with a mix of unresolved bugs and some closed issues, indicating active but potentially understaffed maintenance with reasonable issue tracking but inconsistent resolution timelines.
